post.description: Choose action in Parameters. The body Examples dropdown contains matching examples; changing the action does not automatically change the example. approve requires no body; start and unknown allow no body. reject requires reason. settle requires evidence_id from the evidence upload endpoint; fail requires evidence_reference. Only fields belonging to the selected action are accepted.

approve.description: Use /actions/approve. Omit the body; {} is also accepted.

value.reason: Bank destination could not be verified.

start.description: Use /actions/start. Omit the body or supply a note.

settle.description: First POST an image or PDF to /admin/wallet/withdrawals/{withdrawal_id}/evidence. Use its evidence_id here.

fail.description: Use /actions/fail. evidence_reference is required; note is optional.

unknown.description: Use /actions/unknown. Both fields are optional; the body may be omitted.
